description: This file defines the PlatformSecurityContext interface, which declares methods related to user authentication and access rights within the security service layer of the Fineract project.

classes.name: PlatformSecurityContext
classes.description: An interface defining security-related methods for authenticating users, validating access rights, and handling user session details within the security infrastructure.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedUserIfPresent
methods.description: Returns the authenticated user if present; otherwise, null. Designed to avoid exceptions.

methods.name: validateAccessRights
methods.description: Validates whether the current user has access rights to the specified resource, based on office hierarchy.

methods.name: officeHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the office hierarchy string associated with the current user's context.

methods.name: doesPasswordHasToBeRenewed
methods.description: Determines whether the user's password needs to be renewed.

methods.name: authenticatedUser
methods.description: Returns the authenticated user associated with a specific command wrapper.
